snippet.title: RETRO DRIVE: REVAMPED - 26/06/2025 ON NINTENDO SWITCH 1 & 2!
snippet.description:
Burn rubber through the neon-soaked streets of Retropolis! Experience the ultimate '80s arcade racing adventure with heart-pounding gameplay, customizable rides, and an EPIC synthwave soundtrack featuring Fantom '87, Sunglasses Kid, New Arcades, and more legendary artists.

✨ FEATURES:

Precise arcade racing mechanics
Unlock & customize radical cars
Hunt for VHS collectibles with '80s movie references
Compete for high scores in retrofuturistic Retropolis
Legendary synthwave soundtrack by genre icons

Turn up the volume, hit the gas, and chase your friends through this neon-charged time capsule!
🎮 Available from 26/06/2025 on Nintendo eShop
🎵 Soundtrack featuring synthwave legends
🏁 Pure '80s nostalgia racing action

LINKS:
Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/retro-drive-revamped-switch/
